name: Sim800L → On Sms Received
description:
An action to be performed when an SMS is received. See [`on_sms_received` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/sim800l/#sim800l-on_sms_received).

With this configuration option you can write complex automations whenever an SMS message is received. To use the message content, use a [lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates/#config-lambda) template, the message content and the sender phone number are available inside that lambda under the variables named `message` and `sender` respectively.
